info.title: ClaimCraft BD API
info.description: Bangladesh-first consumer resolution copilot API. Grounded dispute preparation and follow-up.

get.description: Liveness probe: verifies process is alive and responsive.
Readiness probe: reports readiness of database, storage, and models.
Returns enabled domain packs, supported languages, provider readiness, and release mode.
Returns sanitized build inventory and capability status without disclosing secrets.

post.description: Initializes or resumes an isolated anonymous guest session with HttpOnly cookie & JWT.
Upgrades an anonymous guest account to a permanent verified account, retaining cases.
Terminates the current session and clears session cookie.

get.description: Returns authenticated principal profile and roles with Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.description: Records affirmative user consent for processing purposes.
Revokes access immediately and schedules complete background deletion.

get.description: Retrieves non-content status of an active or completed deletion request.

post.description: Creates a new case owned by the authenticated principal.

get.description: Lists non-deleted cases belonging to the calling principal.
Fetches case details with strict tenant isolation (returns 404 for foreign cases).

patch.description: Updates case fields with optimistic concurrency check (returns 409 on version conflict).

delete.description: Revokes access and queues case for complete asynchronous deletion.

get.description: Retrieves chronological activity log and history for an authorized case.

schema.title: Response Get Case Activity V1 Cases  Id  Activity Get

get.description: Retrieves an approved public statutory or procedural provision.
Returns metadata and manifest hash for the active compatible knowledge release.
Reviewer only: inspect discovered and unapproved candidate source versions.

schema.title: Response List Source Candidates V1 Admin Source Candidates Get

post.description: Reviewer only: records explicit named review scope and promotes candidate to approved.
Publisher only: constructs an immutable release manifest; rejects test_only rules (T18).
Publisher only: performs atomic active release pointer swap.
Publisher only: disables active release in an emergency.

get.description: Retrieves all active factual assertions for the authorized case.

schema.title: Response List Case Facts V1 Cases  Case Id  Facts Get

post.description: Creates a normalized factual assertion (money/date/boolean/string) bound to the case.
Submits user review (accept/correct/reject/unsure) for an extracted or asserted fact.
T08: Extracts structured fact proposals and verbatim text spans from the case story narrative.

unsubmitted_banner_notice_en.title: Unsubmitted Banner Notice En
unsubmitted_banner_notice_en.default: UNSUBMITTED DRAFT — Prepared for your personal review. ClaimCraft BD does NOT send or file communications on your behalf. Copying or viewing this draft does not change external filing status.

unsubmitted_banner_notice_bn.title: Unsubmitted Banner Notice Bn
unsubmitted_banner_notice_bn.default: অননুমোদিত খসড়া — শুধুমাত্র আপনার ব্যক্তিগত পর্যালোচনার জন্য প্রস্তুত। ক্লেমক্র্যাফট বিডি কোনো স্বয়ংক্রিয় মেসেজ বা মামলা পাঠায় না। এই খসড়া দেখা বা কপি করা মানেই এটি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে প্রেরিত বা দায়েরকৃত নয়।
